Name: Farm Cave Minecart
Author: Endwyr
Description:
Adds a Minecart to the Farm Cave. That's it. Unlockable through normal methods, compatible with Fruit Bats & Mushrooms.

== 1.6? ==
Fully Compatible!

== Why? ==
It always bothered me that we have a cave clearly on our farm, yet it wasn't connected to the minecart network. I felt like having one in the overworld Farm Map itself was a bit OP, and the Bus Stop minecart sometimes feels inconvenient to use, imo, so I added this. Enjoy! :)
